item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(req,pol,expected):\\n    rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol)\\n    assert got==expected,(req,got,expected)\\n    assert req==rb and pol==pb,'inputs mutated'\\n    assert list(got)==['ok','value','reason']\\n    assert type(got['ok']) is bool and (got['value'] is None or type(got['value']) is str)\\n    assert got['reason'] in {'blocked','permission','retry_limit','ok'}\\n\\np={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'admin'},'x>a':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}\\ncheck({'from':'a','to':'z'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})\\ncheck({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'wrong','attempts':True},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})\\ncheck({'from':'x','to':'a','attempts':True},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})\\ncheck({'from':'x','to':'a','attempts':-1},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})\\ncheck({'from':'x','to':'a','attempts':2},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})\\ncheck({'from':'x','to':'a','attempts':1},p,{'ok':True,'value':'a','reason':'ok'})\\ncheck({'from':'a','to':'b'},p,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('all checks passed',len(report))\"]}"}
